name: Referred Agent 3
definition: Provides the placement agent identification for a hedge fund if the investor was referred by one.

Referred.name: Referred
Referred.definition: Indicates if the investor was referred by a placement agent.

ReferredPlacementAgent.name: Referred Placement Agent
ReferredPlacementAgent.definition: Placement agent that referred the investor.

ReferredPlacementAgentRule.definition: ReferredPlacementAgent may only be present if Referred is REFR (Referred).
